shortDescription: Manage Oracle PKI wallets, certificates, and credentials via orapki

options.name: auto_login
options.description: Type of auto-login wallet to create auto_login creates cwallet.sso alongside ewallet.p12 local_auto_login creates a host-bound auto-login wallet auto_login_only creates only cwallet.sso without ewallet.p12

options.name: cert_alias
options.description: Alias name for the certificate (Oracle 26ai+)

options.name: cert_dn
options.description: Distinguished Name for the certificate (e.g. CN=myserver,O=MyOrg)

options.name: cert_export_file
options.description: Output file path for certificate export

options.name: cert_file
options.description: Path to certificate file (for trusted_cert and user_cert)

options.name: cert_keysize
options.description: Key size for self-signed certificate generation

options.name: cert_state
options.description: State of certificate management operation

options.name: cert_type
options.description: Type of certificate to add (required when cert_state=present) trusted_cert for CA certificates user_cert for server/client identity certificates self_signed for test/development self-signed certificates

options.name: cert_validity
options.description: Validity period in days for self-signed certificates

options.name: change_password
options.description: Whether to change the wallet password

options.name: credential_alias
options.description: Alias name for the credential or entry

options.name: credential_db
options.description: Database connect string / TNS alias for the credential

options.name: credential_password
options.description: Password for the credential (no_log)

options.name: credential_secret
options.description: Secret value for a generic entry (no_log)

options.name: credential_state
options.description: State of credential/secret management operation

options.name: credential_type
options.description: Type of secret store entry credential for database connection credentials (alias/db/user/password) entry for generic secret values

options.name: credential_user
options.description: Username for the credential

options.name: new_password
options.description: New password when changing wallet password (with change_password=true)

options.name: oracle_home
options.description: ORACLE_HOME path where orapki binary is located

options.name: state
options.description: The intended state of the wallet

options.name: wallet_location
options.description: Path to the wallet directory (where ewallet.p12 / cwallet.sso reside)

options.name: wallet_password
options.description: Password for the wallet
